Are Memecoins useful?  🤷🏾‍♂️

Unlike Bitcoin or Ethereum, most memecoins lack utility 🛠️. They’re often speculative assets. However, some build ecosystems over time (e.g., Dogecoin for tipping). 

Always DYOR (Do Your Own Research) before investing! 🔍 https://t.co/52J7wtSBjL

What are Memecoins? 🤔

Memecoins are cryptocurrencies inspired by internet memes or jokes. Think Dogecoin or Shiba Inu they often start as fun projects but can gain massive popularity and value. Let’s explore their world! 🌐 https://t.co/yPZfv12EU0
